issues.issue: "There is no premium charge for this rider" has to be reconciled with the rider's deduction of a "then current Administrative Charge" of up to $300 from the accelerated payment (c155).
"Our discounting rate will be subject to the higher of: 1. 5%; or 2. the Published Monthly Average" does not say whether that higher figure is a floor or a ceiling on the rate the insurer may apply.
The sentence is fragmentary ("The discounted del any other 5 then current Administrative Charge"), so what is subtracted from the discounted benefit cannot be determined from the words.
The enumerated list of values "reduced by the Proportion" is scrambled ("Oo PWN") and includes policy debt, so which items are reduced, and in what order, is not readable from the provision.

The subaccount mechanics presuppose a variable life policy, whereas this contract is a fixed universal life policy with a Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate (c010), making the paragraph inoperative here.
"Any creditor, trustee in bankruptcy or governmental agency, or arising under any court order directed against you" is a mixed list whose general reach against ordinary assignees is left uncertain.
"Home Office approval of form #519B is necessary before the policy is in effect" adds a condition of effectiveness not found in Section 10 (c080) or the application's own list of conditions (c190).
"Base policy is rated" cannot be squared with the Schedule Page entry "Additional Ratings Not Applicable" (c004), which controls the Section 9 Monthly Deduction component for ratings.
The paragraph's clauses are interleaved and unreadable ("payments wili ha shared equally by all primary ben beneilelarles who survive..."), so the default sharing rule cannot be read off the text.
The face amount applied for is illegible and does not match the $6,000,000 recorded by the amendment (c172) and the Schedule Page (c004).
The premium figures shown in the application do not match the amendment's first-year and subsequent planned annual premium of $299,526 (c170, c171) or the Schedule's Planned Premium.
The application's five conditions for insurance to take effect, including payment in full during the insured's lifetime, are not the same conditions stated in Section 10 of the policy (c080).
